title: Sales & Trading Intern
description:
Sobre o Grupo BCP Securities
Fundada em 1989, a BCP Securities, Inc. é uma corretora e banco de investimento americano com foco em renda fixa em mercados emergentes. Com sede em Greenwich, Connecticut, e escritórios em cidades estratégicas como Rio de Janeiro, Miami, Los Angeles, Madrid, Cidade do México e Singapura, a BCP é referência global em soluções financeiras personalizadas. Reconhecida por sua excelência e compromisso ético, a empresa oferece serviços inovadores e eficazes para atender às necessidades de clientes ao redor do mundo.
Sobre a BCP DTVM
A BCP DTVM é uma instituição financeira voltada para originação, estruturação e distribuição de ativos financeiros, com destaque para crédito privado e operações estruturadas. Nossa atuação inclui uma mesa ativa de negociações no mercado secundário, promovendo liquidez e transparência para os clientes.
Expandindo do mercado offshore para o mercado local, a BCP DTVM combina expertise técnica e agilidade, atendendo empresas, investidores institucionais e family offices com soluções sólidas e inovadoras. Somos o lugar certo para profissionais que buscam um ambiente dinâmico e orientado a resultados, contribuindo para o futuro do mercado financeiro brasileiro.
Local de Trabalho: cidade do Rio de Janeiro, 100% presencial
Tipo de Contrato: estágio
Principais Responsabilidades:
Apoiar a mesa de Sales & Trading no acompanhamento diário do mercado local de renda fixa, com foco em crédito privado (debêntures, CRIs, CRAs, notas comerciais e outros instrumentos).
Auxiliar na atualização e controle das posições da mesa, acompanhando marcação a mercado, preços, spreads e movimentações diárias.
Apoiar a equipe de Sales no atendimento a demandas de clientes institucionais, family offices e investidores profissionais, incluindo envio de cotações, informações de mercado e materiais de suporte.
Monitorar e organizar o pipeline de oportunidades no mercado secundário, contribuindo com a execução e acompanhamento de negociações.
Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e "market updates" (diários e semanais), incluindo destaques do mercado, principais movimentos e níveis indicativos.
Utilizar sistemas internos e plataformas de mercado (ex.: Bloomberg, ANBIMA, B3, CETIP/NoMe/RTC, conforme aplicável) para consultas de preços, volumes e informações dos ativos.
Auxiliar na checagem de operações e interface com áreas de Middle/Backoffice, garantindo alinhamento entre negociação, registro e liquidação.
Organizar bases de dados, planilhas e controles internos, garantindo consistência e qualidade das informações.
Apoiar projetos de melhoria de processos e automação de rotinas (Excel/VBA/Python, quando aplicável).
Colaborar com o time na preparação de apresentações, materiais comerciais e documentos de apoio para reuniões com clientes.
Requisitos:
Cursando graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade, Matemática, Estatística ou áreas correlatas.
Interesse genuíno por mercado financeiro, especialmente renda fixa, crédito privado e macroeconomia local.
Excel intermediário/avançado (tabelas dinâmicas, fórmulas, organização de bases).
Boa capacidade analítica, atenção a detalhes e perfil organizado.
Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com postura profissional para interação com áreas internas e clientes.
Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão, com agilidade e priorização em rotina de mesa.
Disponibilidade para estágio presencial na cidade do Rio de Janeiro (Ipanema).
Diferenciais:
Conhecimento básico de produtos de renda fixa (duration, curva, spread, marcação a mercado).
Familiaridade com Bloomberg e/ou plataformas de negociação.
Noções de VBA, Python, Power BI ou automação de relatórios.
Inglês intermediário/avançado.
Benefícios:
Bolsa Estágio
Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa global com forte atuação no mercado de renda fixa.
Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e dinâmico.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
The Production Supervisor will support BW Energy's production operations on Brazilian offshore assets. This position is responsible for supervising daily production activities, ensuring safe and efficient operation of all process plant systems, and coordinating interfaces between operations, maintenance, logistics, and subsurface teams. The role also includes maintaining operational documentation, reporting performance, and ensuring compliance with Company and Client procedures.

Responsibilities

  • Supervise CRO, Production Operators and Laboratory Technician, ensuring clear understanding of roles and responsibilities.
  • Manage daily operation of the production plant, ensuring safe operation in accordance with BW/Client procedures.
  • Ensure accurate reporting and documentation in AMOS and other operational systems.
  • Maintain clear production history of each well and equipment;
  • Identify and report deficiencies, malfunctions, and non-conformities; propose corrective and improvement actions.
  • Prepare the plant for intrusive maintenance and ensure proper coordination with Maintenance and other departments.
  • Understand and apply Isolation Standards (LOTO) and contribute to risk assessments.
  • Manage and maintain operational documentation, including procedures and technical records.
  • Act as Permit to Work (PTW) system coordinator when appointed by the OIM.
  • Administer and monitor COSHH on the FPSO;
  • Interpret logged operational data and support decision-making during routine and abnormal operations.
  • Ensure proper shift handover practices, maintaining continuity of plant awareness.
  • Support daily interface between Engineering, Operations, Logistics, Subsurface, and Maintenance teams.
  • Contribute to KPI tracking, reporting, and production performance monitoring.
  • Support emergency response duties as assigned and maintain full readiness for abnormal situations.
  • Engage in continuous improvement, identifying unsafe conditions and ensuring corrective actions per procedures.
  • Maintain valid certifications and medical requirements relevant to offshore and job-specific duties.

Requirements

Education

  • HNC (Higher National Certificate) in Chemical/Petrochemical field.
  • Engineering degree.
  • Solid and proven experience in production operations.

Experience

  • Experience in chemical/petrochemical industry with offshore operations.
  • Extensive experience in production departments.
  • Experience with FPSO operations and process plant systems (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of operational safety standards and PTW systems.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados
description:
Nesta oportunidade de Engenheiro(a) de Dados, você será responsável por construir e otimizar nossa infraestrutura de dados, também atuará como uma referência técnica e mentor(a), capacitando nossas equipes de Analistas, Especialistas e Cientistas de Dados a extraindo o máximo valor dos nossos ativos de dados, assumindo a propriedade de domínios de dados e garantindo que nossas soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e governadas.

Aqui na Pulse temos compromissos com a equidade de oportunidades para todas as pessoas. Valorizamos as diferenças e temos um ambiente onde todos e todas são mais que bem-vindos, por isso buscamos diversidade em identidade de gênero, idade, cor e etnia, orientação afetivo-sexual, origem, pessoas com deficiência e entre outras diversidades, pois entendemos que todas as pessoas devem sonhar, crescer e realizar.

Para te ajudar a entender este desafio, aqui estão algumas responsabilidades:

  • Construção de Pipelines de Dados: Desenvolver, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) robustos, eficientes e escaláveis, utilizando o ecossistema Azure Databricks, incluindo Databricks Jobs e Delta Live Tables (Pipelines);
  • Otimização e Performance: Otimizar a performance de queries complexas e processos de ingestão e transformação, garantindo o processamento eficiente de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Atuar como referência técnica para o time de dados, promovendo as melhores práticas de engenharia, governança e qualidade de dados, mentorando o time de Dados;
  • Monitoramento e Qualidade: Implementar e manter rotinas de monitoramento que garantam a saúde, a consistência e a qualidade dos nossos pipelines e bases de dados;
  • Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento em Data Mesh: Liderar a concepção e ser o guardião técnico de domínios de dados específicos, garantindo a qualidade, disponibilidade, segurança e documentação dos "produtos de dados";
  • Governança de Dados: Implementar e disseminar estratégias de governança de dados dentro do time, incluindo conhecimento de todos os domínios de dados, garantindo a conformidade e a segurança das informações acessadas;
  • Suporte Estratégico: Colaborar ativamente com stakeholders, Analistas e Cientistas de Dados para entender os requisitos de negócio e traduzi-los em soluções de dados eficazes e estratégicas, disponibilizando datasets prontos para consumo;
  • Disseminação da Cultura Data-Driven: Agir como um evangelista de dados, auxiliando as áreas de negócio a compreender e utilizar os dados disponíveis para tomar decisões mais inteligentes.

Para esta oportunidade, é necessário que você:

  • Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida e comprovada como Engenheiro de Dados, atuando em ambientes de Big Data;
  • Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática com a plataforma Databricks no ambiente Azure (ADB), dominando seu principais componentes como Databricks JOBs, Delta Live Tables, e integração com Azure Data Lake Stirage (ADLS);
  • Domínio avançado de Python e SQL para manipulação e processamento de dados em larga escala;
  • Experiência avançada com Apache Spark / PySpark, incluindo otimização de jobs e performance;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem de dados (Dimensional, Data Vault) e arquitetura de dados;
  • Compreensão profunda e vivência prática com os conceitos e a implementação de arquiteturas Data Mesh;
  • Experiência com práticas e ferramentas de governança de dados (Data Governance), qualidade de dados (Data Quality) e segurança;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento de código, como Git;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, colaboração e mentoria.

É um diferencial se você possuir:

  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados NoSQL, especialmente MongoDB;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

title: Data Product Manager Sr
description:
A área de Dados e Inteligência Artificial (Dados e IA) da Vibra Energia é responsável por construir, operar e evoluir as capacidades corporativas de dados e inteligência, garantindo que dados sejam confiáveis, acessíveis, governados e convertidos em decisões e automações de alto impacto para o negócio. A atuação é end-to-end, cobrindo:

  • Ingestão e integração de dados a partir de sistemas internos e fontes externas
  • Armazenamento e processamento em nuvem, com camadas de data lake/warehouse e serving analítico
  • Modelagem analítica e semântica, padronização de métricas e qualidade de dados
  • BI e analytics avançado, suportando decisões do operacional ao estratégico
  • Ciência de dados, machine learning e IA, do experimento à produção
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos de dados e produtos de IA incluindo automações inteligentes e agentes de IA

A plataforma prioriza Google Cloud Platform (GCP) e padrões cloud-native, com tecnologias como:

  • BigQuery (camada central analítica)
  • Cloud Storage (data lake)
  • Pipelines/orquestração: Cloud Composer (Airflow), Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Workflows
  • Transformação/modelagem: Dataform, padrões ELT/ETL
  • Governança/metadata: Dataplex, Data Catalog
  • BI/consumo: Tableau, Power BI ou Looker
  • IA/ML: Vertex AI (training, endpoints, pipelines), práticas de MLOps/monitoramento

Observabilidade e segurança: Cloud Logging/Monitoring, auditoria, LGPD e eficiência de custos (FinOps). Liderar estrategicamente o portfólio de produtos de dados e IA da Vibra Energia, garantindo alinhamento com a estratégia corporativa e maximização de impacto. Definir padrões de produto (governança, qualidade, adoção, métricas de valor) e impulsionar iniciativas de IA e agentes de IA como produtos escaláveis e seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Definir estratégia e governança do portfólio de produtos de dados/IA (priorização, funding, dependências, capacitação);
  • Conduzir rituais com liderança executiva e áreas-chave para definição de objetivos e roadmap;
  • Implementar modelo de "data product lifecycle": discovery, delivery, operação, evolução e descontinuação;
  • Estabelecer padrões corporativos: métricas oficiais, camada semântica, catálogo, SLAs, data contracts e políticas de acesso;
  • Mensurar valor: ROI, ganhos de eficiência, qualidade, redução de tempo de decisão, risco e compliance;
  • Liderar iniciativas de adoção: enablement, comunicação, governança do consumo (BI: Tableau/Power BI/Looker);
  • Coordenar produtos de IA/agentes: requisitos, segurança, monitoramento, feedback loop, avaliação de performance e mitigação de riscos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência robusta em gestão de produtos de dados/analytics/IA em contexto corporativo;
  • Conhecimento profundo de arquitetura e governança de dados em GCP (BigQuery, pipelines, IAM, catálogo);
  • Experiência com mensuração de valor e gestão de stakeholders executivos;
  • Capacidade de liderar times/squads transversalmente e influenciar prioridades;
  • Diferenciais: operating model de Data & AI, governança de IA (policy, risk), finanças/ROI, agentic systems (quando aplicável).

Competências Técnicas

  • Estratégia de produto aplicada a dados e IA;
  • Governança e métricas corporativas (single source of truth);
  • Gestão de portfólio e mensuração de valor (ROI/impacto);
  • Capacidade de estruturar produtos de agentes de IA com segurança e monitoramento.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Liderança executiva e influência;
  • Visão estratégica e capacidade de tomar decisões com trade-offs;
  • Comunicação de alto nível e negociação;
  • Foco em impacto e excelência operacional.

  • PAE - Auxílio financeiro oferecido no caso de dependentes filhos(as) e/ou enteados(as) com deficiência intelectual

  • 6+ years of professional mobile development experience.

  • Hands-on experience integrating Twilio SDKs in mobile apps.

  • Strong experience consuming REST APIs, ideally built with Laravel.

  • Solid understanding of mobile networking, asynchronous flows, and error handling.

  • Experience implementing mobile security best practices.

  • Strong debugging, profiling, and performance optimization skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building real-time voice, calling, or communication-focused applications.

  • Experience with WebSockets or event-driven mobile architectures.

  • Experience collaborating closely with backend teams on API contracts.

  • Exposure to or frontend concepts for cross-team collaboration.

  • Experience scaling mobile apps with high traffic or real-time usage.

Tech Stack

  • iOS: Swift, Xcode

  • Android: Kotlin, Android Studio

  • Mobile SDKs: Twilio

Nossos valores refletem o jeito DaVita de ser e imprimem em nosso dia a dia o comprometimento constante com excelência em servir, integridade, trabalho em equipe, aprimoramento contínuo, realização pessoal e diversão.

Criada em 2002, na Califórnia, a partir do talento e da vocação da estilista brasileira Paula Hermanny, a ViX Paula Hermanny é uma marca internacional de resort wear reconhecida mundialmente por sua sofisticação, identidade autoral e excelência em cada detalhe. title: Customs & International Freight Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
This role will be responsible for customs operations to ensure compliant, cost-effective, and timely international and domestic movement of goods by managing customs brokerage, documentation, and logistics partnerships. throughout the preparation of the tournament. Will act as the primary liaison for import/export compliance, mitigating risk, resolving transport delays, and optimizing shipping routes.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Compliance and Regulations: Ensuring all cargo meets local and international customs laws, regulations, and tax requirements to avoid delays.
Logistics and Freight Management: Overseeing transportation, negotiating with carriers/forwarders for optimal rates, and managing shipment tracking.
Risk Mitigation and Problem Solving: Proactively addressing issues in the supply chain, such as cargo damage or shipping delays.
Operational Support: Coordinating with internal teams (warehouse, procurement) and external partners (ports, agents) to ensure efficient delivery of goods.
YOUR PROFILE
Education: Engineering, Administration, Economics, International relations or other related areas
Experience: minimum 5 years experience in customs and freight in Brazil.
Collaborative mindset, adaptable and willing to work to tight and changing timelines.
Proficient in analytical thinking and data skills.
Demonstrates positive attitude, patience, persistence, and determination.
Experience working in a multi-cultural, multi-national environment.
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We're a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we've grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Somos mais de 20 mil colaboradores que atuam com foco no propósito de entregar uma melhor saúde diária com humanidade e queremos que você faça parte do nosso time

Para isso, te convidamos a nos conhecer mais em e fazer parte do nosso Banco de Talentos se inscrevendo através dessa vaga.

O que oferecemos:

  • Fazer parte de uma companhia que é certificada como Top Employer, sendo reconhecida pela excelência em suas práticas de RH e gestão. 
  • Crescimento contínuo para alcançar seu máximo potencial. 
  • Experiências únicas ao trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza a saúde e o bem-estar das pessoas e permite que cada um seja sua melhor versão. 

Clique aqui (e veja a história da Patricia e Silva, Diretora Comercial, e saiba como é fazer parte da Haleon Brasil). 

Se identifica e quer entrar para o nosso time também? Então, cadastre-se já e fique de olho nas nossas atualizações. 

 Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It's important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. Note to candidates

title: Analista de Infra Cloud Pleno/Sênior
description:
Buscamos um(a) 
Analista de Infra Cloud
 com foco em 
Microsoft Azure
 para desenhar, provisionar e operar ambientes de alta disponibilidade que sustentam aplicações e times de desenvolvimento. Se você domina App Services, bancos gerenciados e serviços Linux/Windows em Azure — e curte trabalhar lado a lado com Devs — essa vaga é para você.

Suas responsabilidades

  • Provisionar e administrar
     recursos no Azure: App Services (WebApps), Function Apps, Azure SQL/Managed Instance, PostgreSQL/MySQL (Flexible Server), Storage Accounts, Key Vault.
  • Criar e manter infraestrutura para bancos de dados
     (dimensionamento, HA/DR, backup/restore, criptografia, tuning básico).
  • Configurar serviços em Linux e Windows
     (VMs/VM Scale Sets), automação de patching e hardening, DSC/Azure Automation.
  • Desenhar e operar redes
    : VNets, subnets, NSGs/ASGs, Azure Firewall/Application Gateway/Load Balancer, Private Endpoints, DNS, VPN/ExpressRoute (desejável).
  • Observabilidade e confiabilidade
    : Azure Monitor, 
    Application Insights
    , Log Analytics, métricas/alertas, SLO/SLI, troubleshooting de performance.
  • Segurança e governança
    : RBAC/Entra ID (AAD), PIM, Managed Identities, Azure Policy/Blueprints, tagueamento, gestão de custos e FinOps básico.
  • Suporte a times de desenvolvimento
    : criação de ambientes 
    Dev/Test/Prod
    , padrões de release, troubleshooting de pipelines e de aplicações em produção.
  • Automação & IaC
    : padronizar e versionar a infraestrutura com Terraform/Bicep (preferencial), revisões de código (PRs), módulos reutilizáveis.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Azure
    com App Services, bancos gerenciados (Azure SQL/Postgres/MySQL), Storage, Key Vault.
  • Administração de Linux e Windows Server
     em Azure (serviços, usuários, logs, network, tuning).
  • Ambientes voltados ao desenvolvimento
    : boas práticas de versionamento, branching, promoção entre ambientes.
  • Scripting
    : PowerShell e/ou Bash para automação diária.
  • Conhecimentos de rede
     (TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, DNS, NAT, balanceamento).
  • Monitoramento e troubleshooting
     com Azure Monitor, 
    Application Insights
     e Log Analytics.

Diferenciais

  • Pipelines, CI/CD e DevOps
    : Azure DevOps Pipelines e/ou GitHub Actions (gates, approvals, templates, multi-stage).
  • Containers
    : AKS/ACR, orquestração básica, blue/green/canary.
  • FinOps
    : budgets, cost analysis, otimização de reservas/compute.

title: Analista de Relacionamento com Cliente
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DE VAGA – ANALISTA DE RELACIONAMENTO COM CLIENTES
Especialidade: Customer Success – B2B
Sobre a Empresa
A LL Antunes Soluções Construtivas é uma empresa de Engenharia, Manutenção Predial e Obras, com forte atuação no mercado B2B.
Com mais de 11 anos de experiência, atendemos grandes players do varejo e indústrias, entregando soluções técnicas com foco em qualidade, planejamento, relacionamento e resultado.
Sede: Rio de Janeiro – RJ - Site:
Resumo da Função
O Analista de Relacionamento com Clientes (Customer Success – B2B) atua como o responsável pela experiência do cliente, acompanhando-o ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida do relacionamento.
Sua missão é garantir comunicação clara, acompanhamento contínuo, esclarecimento de dúvidas, coleta de feedbacks e aplicação de pesquisas de satisfação, de forma que a satisfação do cliente gere retenção, recompra, fortalecimento do relacionamento e identificação de oportunidades de negócio, além de executar atividades administrativas pontuais relacionadas à gestão da carteira de clientes.
Trata-se de uma função relacional, consultiva e estratégica, com forte integração entre clientes e áreas internas (operações, engenharia, financeiro e comercial), sem atuação como vendedor direto.
Principais Responsabilidades
1. Gestão da Experiência e do Ciclo de Vida do Cliente
Acompanhar clientes desde o início do relacionamento até o pós-serviço/pós-obra;
Garantir que o cliente compreenda claramente:
escopo contratado,
etapas do serviço,
prazos,
fluxos de atendimento;
Atuar como ponto focal de relacionamento, promovendo proximidade, confiança e comunicação fluida;
Realizar contatos recorrentes e organizados (check-ins, follow-ups e pós-atendimento).
2. Relacionamento, Acompanhamento e Suporte ao Cliente
Manter relacionamento ativo e profissional com clientes B2B;
Esclarecer dúvidas relacionadas a serviços, processos, contratos e rotinas internas;
Atuar como interface entre o cliente e as áreas internas (operações, engenharia, financeiro e comercial);
Acompanhar demandas do cliente até sua resolução, direcionando questões técnicas às áreas responsáveis;
Antecipar necessidades e reduzir ruídos, insatisfações e desgastes no relacionamento.
3. Feedbacks, Pesquisas de Satisfação e Retenção
Coletar feedbacks estruturados e recorrentes dos clientes;
Aplicar e acompanhar pesquisas de satisfação (NPS, CSAT ou similares);
Registrar elogios, reclamações, sugestões e pontos de melhoria;
Apoiar ações de retenção de clientes;
Compartilhar percepções e dados com os times internos para melhoria contínua da experiência.
4. Identificação de Oportunidades e Continuidade de Negócios
Identificar novas necessidades, demandas recorrentes ou oportunidades futuras a partir do relacionamento com o cliente;
Estimular a recompra e a continuidade do vínculo de forma consultiva e natural;
Apoiar o time comercial com informações qualificadas sobre oportunidades identificadas;
Contribuir para geração de negócios de forma indireta, a partir da satisfação e confiança do cliente, sem envolvimento em negociação de preços, condições comerciais ou fechamento de vendas, sendo essas atribuições exclusivas da área comercial.
5. Organização, Controle e Atividades Administrativas Pontuais
Manter atualizado o histórico dos clientes (contatos, demandas, feedbacks e oportunidades);
Registrar informações em CRM, planilhas ou sistemas internos;
Apoiar controles administrativos relacionados à carteira de clientes;
Executar atividades administrativas pontuais, tais como:
organização de documentos e informações,
apoio a relatórios simples,
controle de demandas e follow-ups,
suporte a rotinas internas ligadas ao relacionamento com clientes.
Onde Atua
Interface direta com clientes B2B;
Escritório administrativo e ambiente corporativo;
Integração constante com operações, engenharia, financeiro e comercial.
Formação e Qualificações
Obrigatórias
Ensino superior completo ou em andamento (Administração, Comunicação, Gestão, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas);
Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
Organização e domínio de rotinas administrativas;
Conhecimento em Pacote Office (Excel, Word, e-mail).
Desejáveis
Experiência prévia em Customer Success, Relacionamento com Clientes ou Pós-Venda B2B;
Vivência em empresas de serviços, engenharia, manutenção ou facilities;
Experiência com CRM e gestão de carteira de clientes;
Capacidade de leitura de cenários e identificação de oportunidades.
Regime de Trabalho
Regime: CLT
Modelo: 100% Presencial
Horário: Segunda a sexta-feira, das 08h às 18h (1h de intervalo)
Remuneração e Benefícios
Salário: R$ 3.250,00;
Vale Transporte;
Vale Alimentação ao dia: R$ 22,80/dia;
Seguro de Vida;
Plano Odontológico Golden Cross;
Assistência de Saúde por Telemedicina (extensiva a até 3 dependentes);
Auxílio Educação Técnica (conforme política interna);
Investimentos anuais em capacitação (conforme analise gerencial);
Participação em plano de bônus e benefícios por metas coletivas 2026.
Perfil Comportamental Esperado
Organização e visão de processo;
Responsabilidade e comprometimento;
Boa comunicação e postura profissional;
Empatia e escuta ativa;
Proatividade e visão de longo prazo;
Capacidade de lidar com clientes B2B exigentes;
Espírito colaborativo e visão de dono.
Valores Essenciais
Ética – Base de todas as relações;
Transparência – Clareza e verdade nos processos;
Compromisso – Cuidado com os interesses do cliente;
Gratidão – Reconhecimento das pessoas e oportunidades.
Em resumo
Este profissional é fundamental para cuidar do cliente ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida, garantindo satisfação, organização, retenção e geração de oportunidades de forma estruturada e saudável, fortalecendo o relacionamento e a imagem da LL Antunes no mercado B2B.
Sugerimos que o candidato pesquise sobre a LL Antunes e nossa atuação antes de se candidatar.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
Result of Service

The Electrical Engineer reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Six (6) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, an Electrical Engineer is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Electrical Engineer reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Electrical Engineer will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Analyze and review basic architectural and engineering projects, regarding aspects of electrical facilities, telecommunication, and atmospheric discharge protection system. b) Set parameters, standards and requirements for electrical projects, and atmospheric discharge protection systems. c) Set guidelines for evaluating technical studies, electrical projects, and atmospheric discharge protection systems. d) Evaluate and review preliminary design and basic projects of electrical facilities, and atmospheric discharge protection systems regarding the structural systems, sizing, executive techniques, materials specifications, technological tests, and control. e) Review of Program, layout, 3D modeling, façade elements, and preliminary architectural design and basic projects. f) Prepare reports and technical analysis on basic architectural and engineering projects. g) Apply advanced analysis techniques to propose solutions to problems related to architecture, engineering, and complementary projects. h) Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards. i) Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, engineers, and architects. j) Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project. k) Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team. l) Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Electrical Engineer shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 - Basic Electrical/Telecom/Lightning Protection Project For Social Housing Description: A consortium will design the projects, and the Electrical Engineer will analyze the deliveries. The analysis includes three project reviews and technical reports, up to the final approval of the project. Expected delivery date: 90 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – Compatibility inspection - social housing Description: A consortium will design compatibility studies between architecture, structural, electrical, hydro sanitarian, fire, and atmospheric discharge protection system, and the Electrical Engineer will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 180 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (lato or stricto sensu) in Electrician Engineering, or related fields, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree (lato or stricto sensu) in Electrician Engineering. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in electrical and atmospheric discharge protection system projects is required.
• Experience in the context of urbanization of informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, AutoCAD, and Web search engines are required.
• Good command of AutoCAD is required.
• Experience and skills in using AutoCAD Civil 3D is desirable.
• Experience and skills in using BIM are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 (8% part-time) BRL: Total net amount) UNOPS Salary Scale The consultant will receive a total amount of BRL: 6.126, according to the following schedule:
• Payment 1 (84%): Upon delivery and approval of Product 1 (BRL
• Payment 2 (16%): Upon delivery and approval of Product 2 (BRL 990). The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted into the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. Duties and ResponsibilitiesBackground The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners, for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. To expand the programme and seek support to work with the challenges of reducing urban poverty and integrating all segments of the population into the fabric of the city, UN-Habitat is a partner of Instituto Pereira Passos (IPP) of the Municipality of Rio de Janeiro (PCRJ) in the implementation of the Social Territories Programme. To respect, protect and achieve rights and build a fairer and more equitable city, the Social Territories Programme aims to identify the most vulnerable urban population of the city of Rio de Janeiro, better understand their living conditions and promote a specialized support to integrate them into public registries, the network of basic services and the municipal urban fabric. The Social Territories Programme has been implemented, since 2019, first in large favela complexes (Alemão, Chapadão, Cidade de Deus, Lins, Maré, Pedreira, Penha, Jacarezinho, Rocinha and Vila Kennedy), and currently in larger scale throughout the city. To properly continue the Social Territories Programme's implementation, a Technical Assistant is required to support Programme activities in designated areas of the city. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Technical Assistant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Technical Assistant will support the implementation of the programme and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Provide support and orientation to the Programme's families and individuals selected for monitoring under Rio de Janeiro's social policies. b) Provide support and orientation to the Programme's families and individuals selected for monitoring during household visitations in designated territories. c) Access information about families and individuals selected for monitoring using the Integrated Assistance Protocols and other public databases, and refer them to the appropriate public agencies. d) Research complementary information about families and individuals selected for monitoring and forward them to the appropriate public agencies. e) Work in partnership with civil servants in several municipal secretariats (Education, Social Assistance, Health, and so on) in order to increase access to public services for families and individuals selected for monitoring. f) Provide input for the identification and mitigation of bottlenecks within the Integrated Assistance Protocols. g) Maintain professional and cordial relations with the Programme's counterparts. h) Disseminate updated information about the Programme within designated territories. i) Ensure that the Programme's technical activities within the purview of his or her function are aligned with the Agency's and its counterparts' quality expectations. j) Perform other duties which may be requested. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Technical Assistant will support the implementation of the Programme's work plan and daily activities. The consultant shall be paid a monthly allowance upon presentation and approval by the Head of Brazil Office of monthly activities' report.
Qualifications/special skillsEducation Required:
High School Diploma is required, or additional two (2) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement. Desirable:
Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Psychology, Education or related fields. Work experience:
Minimum four (4) years of experience in assisting families in situations of social vulnerability is required.
Knowledge of the National Social Assistance Policy is required.
Experience with the Programme's target communities is required.
Previous experience working in the United Nations is desirable. Skills:
Good handling of technological tools is required.
Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office and Microsoft Excel, is desirable. Competencies
Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.
Languages
English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required. Working knowledge of any other working language of the United Nations is desirable.

title: Programa Jovens Profissionais
description:
A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.
Nossos Valores:
Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição do Programa:
A NTS está oferecendo ao público externo 2 bolsas de pós-graduação em Engenharia de Dutos, na PUC-Rio, 100% gratuitas e exclusivas para mulheres engenheiras.
É necessário ter até 2 anos de formação para participar
Além de realizar a pós-graduação, o profissional estará imerso na área de Integridade de Dutos da NTS, participando de atividades estratégicas para garantir a segurança e confiabilidade das operações. Durante essa experiência, terá contato com inspeções e monitoramento dos dutos, análise de riscos, controle de corrosão, gestão de dados e conformidade com normas regulatórias, além de contribuir para planos de contingência e resposta a emergências. Uma oportunidade única para desenvolver conhecimento técnico e atuar diretamente na preservação dos ativos da companhia.
Requisitos:
Até 2 anos de formação em Engenharia Mecânica, Metalurgica, Química ou de Materiais.
Inglês avançado.
Conhecimento em linguagens de programação e perfil orientado à dados.
Perfil analítico e orientado à inovação.

title: IT Field Support Specialist
description:

title: Architect
description:
Result of Service

The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under these Terms of Reference. The consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Eleven (11) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, local authorities, and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda, with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan, and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis on developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Through a partnership with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) and the Municipality of Belo Horizonte, UN-Habitat is working as Implementing Agency to implement the project named "Urban Qualification in a Key Neighborhood of Belo Horizonte." UN-Habitat will focus on the outcome "Improved Belo Horizonte Municipal infrastructure and tools to develop effective options for social housing and urban planning in Izidora," which aims to enable Izidora´s population to have safe and sustainable access to community infrastructure and affordable housing. The region of Izidora corresponds to an area of about 9.5 km², in the northern vector of the city, next to the southern border of the city of Santa Luzia. This area is in the largest green area of the city, counting around 280 water sources and 64 creeks, including part of the watershed Belo Horizonte's main water source. Part of Izidora has been squatted and is divided into four urban informal settlements - Esperança, Vitória, Helena Greco and Rosa Leão – totalizing approximately 1.5 km² and hosting about 4,200 precarious homes (which could be up to 7,000 families, given that there are no precise numbers since 2010), with families in situations of extreme poverty and without any available public infrastructure and relative services, as many Brazilian cities. During the Habitat III Conference in 2016, Izidora was highlighted as one of the most serious urban land conflicts in Latin America. Therefore, the new efforts of the municipality are a recognition of the issues, as well as the urgency of acting. The interest of the Municipal Administration is to implement works and actions so that Izidora becomes a model under the principles of sustainability and resilience. This is a chance to promote an innovative experience in using the precepts of the New Urban Agenda (NUA) and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) at local level to reverse a situation of socioeconomic and territorial vulnerability. To properly implement this project, an Architect is required to ensure the good execution of the work programme. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Architect reports to the Head of Brazil Office who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Architect will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities:
• Review of Program, layout, 3D modeling, façade elements, and preliminary architectural design.
• Analyze and review basic architectural projects, regarding aspects of dimensioning, urbanism, thermal comfort, ventilation, acoustics, energy efficiency, specifications of materials.
• Prepare reports and technical analysis on basic architectural projects.
• Analyze, review, and propose changes to the technical drawings to ensure quality standards.
• Apply advanced analysis techniques to propose solutions to problems related to architecture and compatibility of projects.
• Provide technical guidance to designers, planners, engineers, and architects.
• Collaborate with other team members to prepare the necessary technical documents corresponding to the project.
• Participate in meetings with other members of the technical team.
• Perform any other technical support tasks to support the project team as required. The consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Architect shall evaluate projects for two (2) occupations of Izidora Neighborhood, which are divided into three (3) areas, and assist the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1: Architectural Preliminary Design Description: A consortium will design the architectural preliminary design, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 80 days after signing the contract. Product 2: Basic Architectural Design Description: A consortium will design the basic architectural design, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 160 days after signing the contract. Product 3: Use, Operation, and Maintenance Manual Description: A consortium will design the manual, and the Architect will analyze the delivery. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 240 days after signing the contract. Product 4: Compatibility inspection – Area 1 and 2 Description: A consortium will design compatibility studies, and the Architect will verify the deliveries. The analysis includes three (3) project reviews and technical reports, up to final design approval. Expected delivery date: 330 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Lato or stricto sensu) in Architecture, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Architecture. Work experience:
• A minimum of six (6) years of progressively responsible experience in basic projects for housing solutions in Brazil is required.
• Experience in architectural projects for social housing is required.
• Experience in urbanistic, and landscaping projects for informal settlements is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN System is desirable. Skills:
• Good computer skills in Windows, such as Microsoft Office, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, and Web search engines are required.
• Experience and skills in using BIM are desirable. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation. approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision. Proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively. Listen to others, interpret messages correctly, and respond appropriately. Show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed. solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management, and consensus facilitation skills. ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity. sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability. willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow for the efficient implementation of the activities related to project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.
• Working knowledge of English or Spanish is desirable.

Additional Information

Travel details: Applicable. The consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. Remuneration LICA 3 (9,5% part-time) BRL: Total net amount) UNOPS Salary Scale The consultant will receive a total amount of BRL: according to the following schedule:

• Payment 3 (12%): Upon delivery and approval of Product 3 (BRL
• Payment 4 (30%): Upon delivery and approval of Product 4 (BRL Notes Appointment against this post is on local basis and only nationals from Brazil or external candidates who hold a permanent visa in Brazil may apply. The extension of this contract is subject to availability of funds and/or performance. Any contract extension is not automatic. It is required for all the curricular information to be inserted into the system, which may take a few hours. Only complete applications in English will be considered. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence. Due to the volume of applications received, receipt of applications cannot be acknowledged individually. Only short-listed applicants will be contacted. title: Continuous Improvement Consultant
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Continuous Improvement consultant to join the Continuous Improvement & Change Management Division, within the Organization Consulting Department.

The Continuous Improvement and Change Management Division leads continuous improvement business level programs, business process management, LSS training, CI assessments and change management consulting services for all organizations within the company.

The role holder will drive organizations to effectively achieve business goals, improving efficiency, and providing value-added solutions to solve and improve operations productivity. Projects will generally be high level in terms of impact and can be tactical as well as strategic

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide continuous improvement internal consulting services, including designing and executing CI programs and projects.
  • Utilize excellent interpersonal and communications skills with the ability to clearly communicate with individual contributors as well as executives.
  • Build sound professional relationships with all levels of management as required to satisfactorily complete projects.
  • Partner with key roles such as project managers, business analysts, and process improvement specialists to deliver business value for the customer.
  • Coach managers and supervisors through continuous improvement and change initiatives and act as a liaison to connect relevant parties and stakeholders.
  • Plan, coordinate, and participate in meetings with a broad range of stakeholders that often includes Project Managers, Business Analysts, and senior leadership to coordinate process improvement efforts.
  • Develop and deliver continuous improvement methodology training for Lean and/or Six Sigma projects.
  • Document definitions and attributes of current processes using visual diagrams, process models, process maps, or other tools as appropriate.
  • Design, lead, and/or contribute to continuous improvement projects/initiatives through planning, assessment, diagnosis, design, and implementation at various levels.
  • Apply a structured Change Management approach and methodology for.
  • Support the development of actionable and targeted Change Management plans to address the people impacts of change due to process improvement and/or technology implementation

Minimum Requirements

  • A Bachelor degree in Business and Management or engineering. A Master's degree is preferable but not essential.
  • Minimum 10 years experience of planning and leading continuous improvement projects and/or programs as either a practitioner/leader or as an internal or external management consultant. Process or manufacturing experience is preferred.
  • LSSBB or Lean Certification or demonstrated 10 years' experience in a continuous improvement role is required.
  • Experience with or certification in Change Management is advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Strong command of organization design and process improvement methodologies and tools.
  • Exceptional communication, persuasion, and stakeholder engagement skills, including executive presence.
  • High proficiency in analytical thinking, problem-solving, and applying structured approaches to complex challenges.

Working environment

Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.

At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

O Hospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Promover e preservar a saúde dos colaboradores no ambiente de trabalho, por meio de ações de medicina preventiva, assistencial e ocupacional, conforme a legislação vigente e as normas da empresa.

Elaborar, coordenar e implementar o PCMSO;

Avaliar as condições de saúde dos colaboradores, identificando fatores de risco ocupacional;

Emitir e controlar atestados de saúde ocupacional (ASO);

Assessorar tecnicamente os setores da empresa quanto às ações de promoção e vigilância em saúde;

Apoiar a CIPA e demais comissões internas de saúde e segurança;

Trabalhar em conjunto com o Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho na identificação e mitigação de riscos à saúde;

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos , de 04/03/1966, de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão


A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

title: Service Engineer
description:
MacGregor is a global company that operates in 30 countries with 2000 employees. We provide sustainable cargo and load handling with a strong portfolio of products, services, and solutions to the maritime and offshore industries. Our solutions are found in over half of the world's merchant fleet.
We believe MacGregor is a great place to work and we are looking for innovators with an international mindset to join our team and help us create lifetime value for our customers.
MacGregor – Let's shape the future together
Are you driven by problem solving? Do you thrive working with complex and large equipment? Look no further, MacGregor is looking to hire a Service Engineer with strong Mechanical and Hydraulic competence. Knowledge of software and automation systems is a significant plus.
The purpose of this role is to execute service, repair and maintenance work, such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, repair of advanced hydraulic and mechanical equipment on the MacGregor product range, mostly cranes and winches.
We are looking for a candidate with previous experience within the offshore, ship, or rig equipment sector working with products such as winches, cranes and steering gears, but not limited to. Your main discipline is mechanical and hydraulic, in addition you have basic knowledge of electrical or/and automation components. As a person you are customer-oriented, cooperative, and have excellent communication skills, with the ability to effectively share information within the team.
This is a position that requires that you travel to client sites, vessels or at shipyards worldwide. Our clients are primarily domestic but also spread across the globe, i.e. Europe, the US, China, Australia, Singapore, and beyond. Therefore, flexibility and a strong willingness to travel is essential. Our office and workshop is located in the Rio de Janeiro area where you might be assigned to local work if needed, therefore it is essential that you live within reach.
More Tasks And Responsibilities
Diagnostics and troubleshooting of mechanical and hydraulic systems
Advanced maintenance on hydraulic and mechanical, basic electrical and automation and maintenance of equipment
Supervise and perform service activities such as refurbishment, upgrades, inspections, preventative maintenance and corrective actions
Stay up to date with relevant developments, routines, processes and news
Provide information and write reports as required
Support sales activities such as follow-up on leads and quotes while at site, as agreed with sales responsible
Follow all site safety rules, agreed working practices and environmental requirements
Comply with all relevant safety and quality requirements according to MacGregor
Reporting directly to the Operations Superintendent. The position will be based in MacGregor's office in Rio de Janeiro, (Niterói / São Gonçalo).
What You'll Need To Succeed
Technical education at Bachelors or Technical College level within Mechanical or Hydraulic. Relevant experience may compensate for lack of education
Minimum 7 years of experience from similar position
Experience with hydraulic and mechanical drawings
Previous experience with winches, cranes, steering gear is a must
Basic knowledge in both automation and/or electrical fields is a valuable asset
Proven experience working with computer systems professionally
Good English language - both verbal and written
Why MacGregor?
Our people are behind every success. People create the technology and product lifecycle solutions that make us great, our people are the ones who innovate, and people drive our business forward. With us you will be part of an international collaborative working culture with challenges and opportunities to further develop yourself professionally. We enable sustainable global maritime operations by maximizing efficiency in cargo and load handling.
Values guide our work
Integrity steers all our thinking, behaviour and the relationships with our customers and other stakeholders
Quality is valued in our processes, products and services and helps to improve our customers' performance and our own competences
Safety is essential in everything we do
MacGregor is an equal opportunity employer. We recognise that diversity is key to our continued success, and strive to maintain a fair and equitable recruitment process for all applicants.
Additional Information
Do you have questions regarding the role? Please contact Vinicius Lima, Operations Superintendent at
Kindly note that we will only review CVs and applications submitted in English through our recruitment portal. Unfortunately we do not consider CVs sent via email.
If you are ready to step into an exciting new role where you can make a significant impact and contribute to the success of MacGregor, apply today
Please apply by 20 February

title: FARM GLOBAL
description:
Descrição da vaga
A nossa história começou há 27 anos, em um pequeno estande na Babilônia Feira Hype, onde dois amigos, Kátia Barros e Marcelo Bastos, compartilhavam suas criações e espalhavam boas energias. o que nasceu no coração do Rio logo conquistou a cena local, ganhou o Brasil e se transformou no que somos hoje.
Em 2019, cruzamos fronteiras e levamos o estilo de vida da FARM Rio para o mundo. de Nova York a Los Angeles, de Paris a Londres, nossas cores, estampas e essência seguem inspirando pessoas pelos quatro cantos do planeta. e seguimos sonhando, criando e levando o Brasil no coração para cada lugar que nos recebe.
Hoje temos no nosso ecossistema as marcas FARM RIO BR, FARM RIO GLOBAL, FARM Etc, FARM LATAM e FABULA , com mais de 120 lojas e 2000 mil colaboradores temos a missão de fazer o outro mais feliz que entrou.
Somos GENTE Boa, bom de GENTE, e bom de JOGO e acreditamos que a gentileza, o encantamento, a paixão, a inclusão e eficiência são a chave de tudo que fazemos.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
Responsável por executar e operacionalizar todas as iniciativas de Treinamento e Cultura, garantindo organização, logística, qualidade e padronização dos processos, desde a preparação de conteúdos até o acompanhamento de treinamentos e eventos.
Apoiar a execução de todas as frentes de treinamento, ajudando na organização de conteúdos, agendas e materiais.
Realizar a logística e operacionalização dos ambientes de desenvolvimento: gravações, transmissões no TEAMS, eventos presenciais, gestão de conteúdos na plataforma de treinamento e desenvolvimento, e nos canais de comunicação interna.
Auxiliar na roteirização, produção executiva, gravação, edição e organização de materiais complementares.
Acompanhar e dar suporte na realização de movimentos de desenvolvimento (Onboarding, programas de liderança, formações, workshops e eventos anuais).
Garantir controle de prazos, checklist de produção e padronização das entregas.
Coletar feedbacks e apoiar na avaliação da eficácia dos treinamentos.
Trabalhar em parceria com a liderança para viabilizar as ações da área, assegurando que as etapas operacionais estejam concluídas dentro do prazo e padrão esperado.
Requisitos e qualificações
Ensino superior/técnico (completo).
Inglês fluente (obrigatório), contato direto com o time comercial das lojas fora Brasil.
Boa comunicação oral e escrita (Inglês e Português).
Organização e atenção aos detalhes.
Habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultaneamente.
Experiência em apoio a projetos de Treinamento & Desenvolvimento ou áreas afins.
Conhecimento básico de ferramentas de edição e plataformas de transmissão (diferencial).
GRUPO SOMA agora É AZZAS 2154 FASHION & LIFESTYLE
Impulsionar o poder criativo da moda brasileira para o mundo
Somos apaixonados por criar, inovar e transformar o mundo da moda com estilo, propósito e gente boa.
Por aqui, acreditamos no poder das ideias, na força da colaboração e na beleza da diversidade. Valorizamos quem faz, quem pensa diferente, quem aprende todos os dias e quem topa evoluir junto.
Se você busca um lugar onde pode ser quem é, contribuir de verdade e fazer parte de histórias que inspiram, aqui pode ser o seu próximo capítulo.
